The four fixtures have inert ELF headers and no executable code. Their icons are opaque green. The result-row tests check pixels uploaded to egui and the texture painted beside the filename.

* `linked-png.AppImage` wraps an XZ SquashFS in an ELF64 Type 2 header. The root `.DirIcon` links to `app.png`, which links to `icons/icon.png` (256 × 256).
* `direct-svg.AppImage` wraps a Zstandard SquashFS in an ELF32 Type 2 header. Its last ELF section extends beyond the section table. The root `.DirIcon` contains the SVG itself.
* `cyclic.AppImage` wraps a gzip SquashFS. Its `.DirIcon` links back to itself.
* `rock-ridge.AppImage` uses an ELF64 Type 1 header in the system area of an ISO 9660 image. The Rock Ridge `.DirIcon` symlink points to `green.svg`.

The SquashFS filesystems were generated by mksquashfs 4.7.5 with the selected compressor and `-noappend -nopad -all-root -no-xattrs -all-time 0 -mkfs-time 0`. The ISO was generated with `bsdtar -c --format=iso9660 --options iso9660:!pad`. Linux CI also extracts the icon from the actual Drill release package generated during that run.
